newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM sees low Alumbrera net copper cost.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM sees low Alumbrera net copper cost.

text.p: MIM Holdings Ltd chief executive Nick Stump said on Friday massive gold credits at the group's new Alumbrera copper/gold mine in Argentina meant the net copper cost of the project is below 30 U.S. cents.

"Gold credits mean the net copper cots of Alumbrera is below 30 cents a pound. It's a very high grade gold zone and the net copper cost will be considerably below 30 cents a pound," Stump told a Securities Institute of Australia briefing.
MIM is 50 percent owner and operator of Alumbrera. North Ltd and Rio Algom Ltd own 25 percent.

Alumbrera, in Argentina's northwestern province of Catamarca, is scheduled to start production in the second quarter of 1997, working up to an annual rate of 700,000 tonnes of intermediate mine concentrate containing 180,000 tonnes of copper metal.
